howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.goal: Be the first to bring all four of your animals from your yard, around the board and into the centre.
howToPlay.turns: Players take turns clockwise. Roll the dice, then move one animal exactly that many squares.
howToPlay.enter: You need a six to move an animal out of your yard onto your coloured start square.
howToPlay.bonus: Rolling a six, capturing an opponent or bringing an animal home earns one extra roll. Three sixes in a row forfeits the third roll.
howToPlay.capture: Land on a lone opponent to send it back to its yard. Start squares and star squares are safe — no captures there.
howToPlay.blockade: Two of your animals on the same square form a blockade that opponents cannot pass or land on.
howToPlay.home: After a full lap your animals turn into their own coloured lane. You must roll the exact number to reach the centre.
howToPlay.win: The match continues until every player but one has brought all four animals home, giving a full ranking.
